Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 29-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Applications of AI in Government and Business [CSE_4097]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Apply the steps of a typical Deep Learning Process to explain how a neural network learns to            (5)  
  classify handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Analyze how machine learning can be applied to reduce urban traffic congestion using the                (5)  
  TranSEC model as a reference.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Analyze how different types of data storage systems (SQL, NoSQL, and object storage) influence          (5)  
  the scalability and efficiency of recommendation engines in handling user interactions and ratings.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Apply the concept of data analysis techniques in recommendation systems to determine how real-          (3)  
  time, batch, and near-real-time methods can be used for generating relevant user  
  recommendations in different scenarios.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Analyze the categories used for general classification of data by recommendation systems and            (2)  
  explain how each category contributes to generating personalized recommendations.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3)                Apply the concept of sentiment analysis to explain how businesses can improve decision-making.          (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                        Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Analyze the challenges posed by complex expressions and opinion characteristics in sentiment            (3)  
  analysis and describe the elements influencing sentiment interpretation.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           Analyze how NLP-based chatbots enhance customer service efficiency?                                     (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Apply the concept of descriptive analytics to illustrate how it serves as a foundation for predictive   (5)  
  
  Page #1

and prescriptive analytics in the evolution of AI-driven business intelligence systems.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Apply the concept of predictive analytics to demonstrate how it is used by experts in the healthcare (3)  
  sector.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)                Analyze any two benefits of descriptive analytics.                                                     (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)                        Analyze how the "Four Automation Approaches" can be utilized to redesign and improve the               (5)  
  workflow of a government department.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                Analyze how cognitive insights can be applied to large public datasets for predictive decision-        (3)  
  making.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Apply the understanding of cognitive insight applications and list its benefits.                       (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
